title: Trajan's Empire at Its Largest
objective: After this level you can describe Trajan's conquests and the empire at its greatest extent.
summary: Trajan, born in Spain, conquered Dacia and pushed into Mesopotamia. In 117 CE the empire reached its greatest extent.

cards.headline: The empire reached its largest size under an emperor born in Spain.
The best emperor
cards.body: Trajan, born in Spain, was the first emperor from outside Italy. He ruled from 98 to 117 CE, and the Senate gave him the title Optimus, “the best.” His reign fell in the middle of the Pax Romana, when the empire’s interior was largely at peace even as its armies fought on the frontiers.

cards.headline: Conquest
cards.body: Trajan conquered Dacia, roughly modern Romania, in two wars ending in 106 CE. Under him the empire reached its greatest extent, in 117 CE, after he conquered lands as far as Mesopotamia.

cards.fact: Trajan’s Column tells the story of the Dacian wars in stone.
cards.context: A spiral band of carvings winds up the column from base to top, showing the campaigns scene by scene.
